data.exact_reserve_text:
Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience.
The underwriting loss of GBP 151,717k, analysed below, comprises adverse movements on all underwriting years.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2007 RITC / Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice
prior_year_events.impact_description: Liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened prior to the external RITC transaction; the liabilities for 2007 were strengthened by GBP 5,833k prior to the RITC being concluded.
The 2013 underwriting year closed and the final amounts settled by members was GBP 41,292k (cash settled during the financial year).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a materially adverse prior-year development in 2016. Management states loss experience across all years was significantly worse than anticipated and reserves were strengthened. The gross claims triangle analysis (gross basis) shows adverse movements concentrated in underwriting years up to and including 2014, producing an aggregate gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 226.1m. The 2007 RITC/Italian public hospital medical malpractice exposures also required targeted strengthening before close and the 2013 year was closed and settled during the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was not explicitly stated as a single gross figure in the movement note; PYD was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) excluding the aggregate 'Before 2011' column per instructions. The triangle is presented in GBP 000; the computed PYD of GBP 226.146m is therefore derived from the individual underwriting-year columns 2011-2014 (2015 and 2016 excluded). There is a known RITC/closure of the 2007 year (strengthening of GBP 5.833m) which affects older-year comparatives; aggregate 'Before 2011' is an excluded aggregate column. Exact textual descriptions indicate reserves were strengthened across all years, providing qualitative confirmation but not an explicit gross PYD amount.
